'''Jyn N'oram''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Jyn N'oram worked for [[Hedrett Shipping and Investments]] as the [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] of the ''[[Fricasseed Nerf]]'', a [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], she was aboard the ship when it collided with a [[Comet/Legends|comet]] fragment in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] and was left drifting in space. However, she and the rest of the crew of the ''Nerf'' were rescued by the [[Heroes of Cularin]].
